counting: Per host, scenario, and check, over trials 1-5, from report-trials.json (report.json pools counts across scenarios). A trial counts toward min_pass only with the result pass; fail, inconclusive, setup-blocked, and invalid do not count. The mark is met when the pass count is at least min_pass. Same marks on both hosts: no prior observation separates them, and the rewritten skills state P3, P4 and K2 for both hosts. Five trials do not support claims of statistical significance.
